ModMetaData.name: Downgrade
ModMetaData.author: DaraynLB
ModMetaData.description: Downgrade adds a Reroll button to raiders and other pawns. Pick an era (Neolithic, Medieval, Industrial, Spacer or Ultra) and every weapon, armor piece, implant and combat drug above that era is replaced with era gear of the same value. Leftover value buys quality, then combat traits. Raids stay as big and as aggressive as before; only their gear fits your game. Requires Harmony. Works with or without Combat Extended.
